hook.name: PrismReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A PRISM token-pool hook collecting a 1.2% fee on all swaps: buy fees accumulate as ETH in a reflection pot; sell fees go to the token contract as reflections. Every 20 swaps it queues a buyback via a flag; the buyback is not automatic and must be triggered manually via buyAndReflectPrism(), which uses the pooled ETH to buy back PRISM and distribute it. When a token is flagged, afterSwap reverts sells from addresses not on the owner-controlled canReflect allowlist.
